exclusions.source_text: Patients ≤ 21 years of age (birth to 21 years of age) at the time of study enrollment will be eligible.
Karnofsky ≥ 50% for patients \> 16 years of age and Lansky ≥ 50 for patients ≤ 16 years of age
Serum creatinine within normal institutional limits, or Creatinine clearance or radioisotope GFR ≥ 70ml/min/1.73 m2
Total bilirubin ≤ 2.5 × institutional upper limit of normal AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤ 2.5 × institutional upper limit of normal
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin <= 2.5 x ULN; AST/ALT <= 2.5 x ULN

exclusions.source_text: Pregnant or breast-feeding women will not be entered on this study
Patients must not have any active, uncontrolled systemic bacterial, viral or fungal infection.
